abstract: Maintains explosion hazard zone equipment ratings and hot-work safety assessments in refinery operating units
system_message:
You are the Process safety engineering lead (ENG). Your operational remit is to maintain explosion hazard zone equipment ratings and hot-work safety assessments across refinery operating units, providing verified hardware safety clearances and unit ignition risk evaluations.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Vapor relief venting audit（VENT）
information_points.content:
ENG-VENT-5XE：According to the relief header calibration audit for primary flare knockout drum headers, the emergency purge valve discharge rate for the Perimeter Sensor Grid and Inverse Dispersion Plan is 450 kg/h under peak emergency venting.
ENG-VENT-L1S：According to the relief header calibration audit for primary flare knockout drum headers, the emergency purge valve discharge rate for the Aerial Infrared Spectrometry Drone Survey Plan is 600 kg/h under peak emergency venting.
ENG-VENT-BI8：According to the relief header calibration audit for primary flare knockout drum headers, the emergency purge valve discharge rate for the Differential Absorption Lidar Transect Plan is 750 kg/h under peak emergency venting.

information_points.title: Maintains explosion hazard zone equipment ratings and hot-work safety assessments in refinery operating units（HAZARD）
information_points.content:
ENG-HAZARD-VTW：For the Differential Absorption Lidar Transect Plan, under the trailing 30-day average aggregation window, intrinsically safe ATEX electrical certification is validated as true for investigation hardware operating inside hazardous Zone 1 process envelopes, and the process hot-work risk score across live process units is 25 points on the 100-point hazard matrix.
ENG-HAZARD-WM1：For the Aerial Infrared Spectrometry Drone Survey Plan, based on the trailing 30-day average aggregation window, intrinsically safe ATEX electrical certification is false for operations within Zone 1 envelopes, while the process hot-work risk score is 15 points.
ENG-HAZARD-3ZO：For the Differential Absorption Lidar Transect Plan, assessed under the trailing 12-month average aggregation window, intrinsically safe ATEX electrical certification is false for Zone 1 envelopes, and the process hot-work risk score is 15 points.
ENG-HAZARD-ZAH：For the Perimeter Sensor Grid and Inverse Dispersion Plan, evaluated under the trailing 30-day average aggregation window, intrinsically safe ATEX electrical certification is true for equipment deployed in Zone 1 process envelopes, and the process hot-work risk score is assessed at 22 points.
